scope: Cloud ROS 2 Humble viewer pose and release checks; no aircraft, actual flight or desktop rendering
root_cause: Viewer directly copied FAST_LIO IMU orientation, so arrow +X could differ from vehicle body +X by the configured mounting rotation. Current nominal body/IMU yaw is 45 degrees.
correction: R_world_body = transpose(R_aligned_world) * R_aligned_body; quaternion used only by the visualization pose publisher
pure_rotation_cases: Identity and half-turn raw attitudes with nontrivial world rotation and nominal mounting; reconstructed body +X and quaternion checked
unmodified: ground 0.5 m and physical 1.5 m heights
limitations: Actual Qt rendering and visual agreement on the onboard desktop remain to be checked. No new complete mission or physical flight is claimed.
